weather_report:
Late morning in Subiaco arrives under a thickening quilt of cloud, the sun mostly a rumor behind it. Light rain is due by midafternoon, more a polite tap on the shoulder than a downpour, with the sky loosening into broken cloud toward evening. It won’t be a notably sunny day; instead expect soft, silvery light and edges a little smudged until the showers move on. Even so, spring’s bite is real here: the UV will surge to high levels when the sun breaks through and still slip through cloud, so a touch of sunscreen is sensible.

Dress in light layers and carry a trim rain shell; shoes that don’t mind damp footpaths will serve you well. The mood suits a slow lunch, a quiet browse in a book or record shop, or a short, unhurried wander between showers to feel the air change. Save longer outdoor plans for the clearer breaks, watch the western sky for openings, and enjoy the gentle, washed look that makes the afternoon feel unhurried and kind.
